title: Huffman revisited, Part 4: Multi-bytes decoding
relevance: Primary reference for multi-symbol Huffman tables. Describes the 2-symbol decode approach with practical benchmarks showing 20-40% improvement.

title: Huffman Performance (cbloom rants)
relevance: Detailed performance analysis of various Huffman decode strategies including multi-symbol tables. Compares conditional vs unconditional refill and 2-decode vs 4-decode per refill.

title: A 280mV 3.1pJ/code Huffman Decoder for DEFLATE Decompression Featuring Opportunistic Code Skip and 3-way Symbol Generation
relevance: Hardware DEFLATE decoder using 3-way parallel symbol generation and code skipping. Demonstrates multi-symbol decode in hardware achieving 2.4x speedup over serial.
